examples.en: The scandal brought discredit on the family.
examples.cn: 丑闻让这个家庭蒙羞。

dict_mnemonic.text: discredit ＝ dis-（去掉）＋ credit（信任、信用，拉丁语 credere「相信」）＝把信任拿掉，「使不可信、使丢脸」；同根还有 credible（可信的）、credibility（可信度）、credulous（轻信的）。

root: 拉丁语 credere（相信）→ creditum（被托付之物）→ 意大利语 credito → 英语 credit → 加 dis- 成 discredit

sensesIntro.en: Trust removed: a smeared scientist, a theory struck out and a nameplate off the door.
sensesIntro.cn: 被拿走的信任：被抹黑的科学家、被划掉的理论与被撬下的名牌。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a seal on a certificate crossed out in black ink while a red line strikes a witness statement
core.cn: 核心意象：证书上的印章被黑笔涂掉，同时一条红线划去证词

branches.en: A report aimed at the reputation of a scientist.
branches.cn: 一篇冲着科学家名誉去的报道。

branches.en: New evidence striking out an old theory.
branches.cn: 新证据划掉旧理论。

branches.en: A nameplate pried off an office door.
branches.cn: 从办公室门上撬下的名牌。

branches.en: Both make people stop believing.
branches.cn: 两者都让人不再相信。

branches.en: Both leave a mark that others can see.
branches.cn: 两者都留下别人看得见的痕迹。

intro.en: Discredit is dis- plus credit; the believe root also builds credible, credibility and credulous.
intro.cn: discredit 由 dis- 加 credit 构成；相信这个词根也造出 credible、credibility 与 credulous。

latinIntro.en: Latin credere means to believe, creditum a thing entrusted and credulus believing too easily.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 credere 意为相信，creditum 意为被托付之物，credulus 意为过于轻易相信的。

definition_zh: 贵族；贵族出身的人；（比喻）最佳者、翘楚
definition_en: a member of the highest social class, especially one born into nobility
core_image: 世袭纹章下坐于高位的世家子弟
scene: 宴会厅里烛光摇曳，宾客个个佩着家传徽章。 The old aristocrat greeted every guest with courtly grace.
sceneCN: 这里 aristocrat 是「贵族」（第 1 个义项：世袭上层阶级成员）；句意是老贵族以典雅的仪态向每位宾客致意。

collocations.phrase: an aristocrat of the old regime

derivatives.zh: aristocrat 加形容词后缀 -ic，义为「贵族的；气派高雅的」
aristocrat 的抽象名词，义为「贵族阶层；贵族政体」
aristocratic 加 -ally，义为「贵族派头地」
同缀对照词，kratos（民众统治）换成 demos（人民），义为「民主」

senses.title: A member of the nobility
senses.titleCN: 贵族；世袭上层阶级成员
senses.definition: a person born into the highest hereditary social class, holding rank or titles
senses.definitionCN: 出身于最高世袭社会阶层、拥有爵位或头衔的人
senses.example: Hundreds of aristocrats fled France during the Revolution.
senses.exampleCN: 大革命期间数百名贵族逃离法国。
senses.why: The Greek root aristo- means best, and the best-born were the nobles.
senses.whyCN: 希腊词根 aristo- 意为「最好的」，出身最显赫者即贵族。

senses.title: A person of aristocratic manner
senses.definition: anyone whose style, manners or tastes suggest the refined elegance of the nobility
senses.definitionCN: 举止品味带有贵族式优雅气派的人，不论出身
senses.example: Though poor, she carried herself like an aristocrat.
senses.exampleCN: 她虽穷，举手投足却像位贵族。
senses.why: The manner is detached from the class and taken as a quality in itself.
senses.whyCN: 气派脱离阶级，本身成为可独立拥有的品质。

senses.title: The finest of its kind
senses.definition: something regarded as the best or most distinguished of its class
senses.definitionCN: 被视为同类中最优秀、最出众的事物
senses.example: This saffron is the aristocrat of all spices.
senses.exampleCN: 这种藏红花是香料中的极品。
senses.why: Aristo- literally means best, so the word returns to its root when ranking things.
senses.whyCN: aristo- 本义即「最好」，比喻义实际上是向词根的回归。

intro.en: Aristocrat comes from Greek aristokrates, a person of the best rule, from aristos and kratos.
intro.cn: aristocrat 源自希腊语 aristokrates，由 aristos（最好的）与 kratos（权力）构成。

items.en: Roots *h2er- (fit together) and *kratos-related stems are reconstructed for best and power.
items.cn: 「最好」与「权力」两词根被分别重构为 *h2er- 及 kratos 相关词干（重构形式）。

items.en: Aristos meant best; kratos meant power or rule; aristokrates named one of the best ruling class.
items.cn: 希腊语 aristos 意为「最好的」，kratos 意为「权力」，aristokrates 指最优统治阶层的一员。

items.en: Aristokratia named government by the best citizens, first a political, not a birth, category.
items.cn: aristokratia 本指「贤良治国」，最初按德才而非血统划分。

items.en: French aristocrate spread in the 18th century, often as a hostile label before the Revolution.
items.cn: 法语 aristocrate 在 18 世纪流行，大革命前常作贬斥标签。

items.en: English borrowed aristocrat in the 1790s in the French political sense.
items.cn: 英语在 18 世纪 90 年代借入 aristocrat，取其法国政治语境义。

items.en: Today it names nobles by birth and, figuratively, the finest of any class of things.
items.cn: 现代英语既指出身贵族，也比喻各类事物中的极品。

note.en: The family splits into a person (aristocrat), a class (aristocracy) and a style (aristocratic).
note.cn: 词族分工：指人的 aristocrat、指阶层的 aristocracy、指风格的 aristocratic。

entries.definition: the noble class or rule by nobles
entries.definitionCN: 贵族阶层或贵族政体，aristocrat 的同根抽象名词

entries.definition: a ruler with absolute power
entries.definitionCN: 独裁者，同用 -crat（掌权者）后缀但前半不同

entries.definition: an official in a government department
entries.definitionCN: 官僚，同用 -crat 后缀的词族成员

entries.definition: a person of high hereditary rank
entries.definitionCN: 贵族，泛指世袭高位者，是 aristocrat 的近义词

entries.definition: a member of the ancient Roman nobility or any high-born person
entries.definitionCN: （古罗马的）贵族或泛指出身高贵者，与 aristocrat 义近

entries.definition: a Spanish or Portuguese nobleman of the highest rank
entries.definitionCN: （西、葡）最高爵位的显贵，与 aristocrat 义近而语域更窄

normalIntro.en: Break the word into aristos (best) + crat (ruler).
normalIntro.cn: 把词拆成 aristos（最好）加 crat（掌权者）。

normal.en: aristos = best; crat = power: the best who rule.
normal.cn: aristos 意为「最好」，crat 意为「权力」：居上而治的「最优者」。

normal.en: The -crat family: autocrat, bureaucrat, technocrat.
normal.cn: -crat 词族：autocrat、bureaucrat、technocrat。

normal.en: aristocracy is the class; aristocrat is one member.
normal.cn: aristocracy 是阶层，aristocrat 是其中一员。

normal.en: aristocratic describes refined high-class manners.
normal.cn: aristocratic 形容高雅的贵族做派。

normal.en: Figuratively, the aristocrat of tea means the finest tea.
normal.cn: 比喻用法：the aristocrat of tea 即「茶中极品」。

abstract.en: Picture a man with a gold-topped cane inspecting a vineyard he never worked.
abstract.cn: 想象执金柄手杖者巡视自己从未耕作的葡萄园。

abstract.en: Hear the slow, unhurried voice that assumes it will be obeyed.
abstract.cn: 聆听那种理所当然会被人服从的从容语调。

abstract.en: See a family crest carved over a manor gate for three hundred years.
abstract.cn: 想象庄园门楣上刻了三百年的家族纹章。

examples.en: The young aristocrat spent his inheritance on travel and books.
examples.cn: 年轻的贵族把家产花在游历和书籍上。

examples.en: She married an impoverished aristocrat with a grand name.
examples.cn: 她嫁给了一位名头显赫却家道中落的贵族。

examples.en: Connoisseurs rank this vintage as the aristocrat of Burgundies.
examples.cn: 行家们把这款年份酒列为勃艮第酒中的翘楚。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱丽事不缺」——贵族小姐爱丽从小仆人环绕，凡事不用自己动手，什么都不缺，真是「爱丽事不缺」。

root: 希腊语 aristos（最好）+ kratos（权力、统治）→ aristokrates（居于权力之最优者）；-crat 后缀同族词有 autocrat、bureaucrat、technocrat。

sensesIntro.en: From born nobles to anyone with lordly manner and figuratively to the finest of a kind.
sensesIntro.cn: 由世袭贵族延伸到有贵族气派者，再比喻为同类中的极品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the best-born sitting at the top of the social ladder
core.cn: 核心意象：出身最优者端坐社会阶梯之顶

branches.en: rank fixed by birth
branches.cn: 由血统固定的等级

branches.en: elegance detached from the class
branches.cn: 脱离阶级的优雅做派

branches.en: excellence as modern aristos
branches.cn: 作为现代「最优」义的卓越

branches.en: privilege shown in bearing
branches.cn: 仪态中透出的特权感

branches.en: the best of a class of things
branches.cn: 一类事物中的最优者

intro.en: The Greek suffix -crat builds words for power-holders of every kind.
intro.cn: 希腊语后缀 -crat 构成各类掌权者的称谓。

latinIntro.en: The -cracy family names the systems those holders run.
latinIntro.cn: -cracy 词族命名这些掌权者运作的制度。

latinEntries.meaning: one of the best ruling class

definition_zh: 洋流；海洋中沿固定方向持续流动的水体
definition_en: a continuous, directed flow of seawater, set in motion by winds, by differences in temperature and salinity, or by tides
core_image: 海面或深海里藏着一条看不见的河，两岸都是海水，水却固执地朝同一侧走
scene: 海洋课上，老师指着海图上从热带伸向高纬的蓝色带子说， An ocean current carries warm water far from the equator.
sceneCN: 这里 ocean current 指「海洋中沿固定方向持续流动的水体」（第 1 个义项：泛指洋流）；句意为：一股洋流把暖水从赤道带向远方。

pos.zh: 洋流；海洋中沿固定方向持续流动的水体

derivatives.zh: 西边界流（沿大洋西缘向极地流动的强而窄的洋流）
边界流；沿海岸或海盆边缘流动的洋流
风生流；由盛行风推动的表层洋流
海流计；测量流速与流向的仪器
温盐流；由温度与盐度差异驱动的深层水流

senses.title: Seawater that keeps to one direction
senses.titleCN: 沿固定方向持续流动的海水
senses.definition: a continuous, directed movement of seawater that persists over long distances
senses.definitionCN: 在长距离上持续保持同一方向的海水流动
senses.example: An ocean current can be as steady as a river in its channel.
senses.exampleCN: 一股洋流可以像河道里的河水一样稳定。
senses.why: the phrase simply names the sea's version of a river: water that runs in a channel of its own, marked out by heat, salt and wind rather than by banks.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语只是给海里那条「河」命名：水在自己的通道里奔跑，通道由热、盐与风划定，而不是由河岸划定。

senses.title: The wind-driven surface flow
senses.definition: the current in the upper ocean, set in motion and shaped by the prevailing winds
senses.definitionCN: 上层海洋中由盛行风驱动并塑造的水流
senses.example: The trade winds drive a surface ocean current westward along the equator.
senses.exampleCN: 信风驱动表层洋流沿赤道向西流动。
senses.why: wind drags the top of the sea the way it drags a cloth, so the uppermost layer becomes the current that pulls the rest along.
senses.whyCN: 风拖动海面，像拖动一块布，于是最上面那层水成了拖动其余水体的洋流。

senses.title: The density-driven deep flow
senses.definition: the slow current of cold, dense water in the deep ocean, driven by differences in temperature and salt
senses.definitionCN: 深海中由温度与盐分差异驱动的寒冷高密度水的缓慢流动
senses.example: A deep ocean current carries Antarctic water north along the sea floor.
senses.exampleCN: 一股深层洋流沿海底把南极的水向北输送。
senses.why: cold and salty water is heavy, so it sinks and pushes along the bottom; gravity, not wind, is the engine here.
senses.whyCN: 又冷又咸的水更重，于是下沉并沿底部推进；这里的动力是重力，不是风。

senses.title: The narrow current at a coast
senses.titleCN: 沿海岸流动的窄而急的水流
senses.definition: a strong, narrow current that runs along the edge of a continent, such as the Gulf Stream or the Kuroshio
senses.definitionCN: 沿大陆边缘流动的强劲窄流，如墨西哥湾流或黑潮
senses.example: This boundary ocean current keeps the harbour ice-free in winter.
senses.exampleCN: 这股边界洋流使港口在冬季不结冰。
senses.why: water piled against a coast has only the edge to escape along, so it narrows and speeds up, which is why such currents are the fastest in the sea.
senses.whyCN: 被堆到岸边的水只能沿边缘找出路，于是变窄、加速，这正是这类洋流成为海中流速最快者的原因。

senses.title: The currents along the equator
senses.definition: the eastward and westward currents that run parallel to the equator, driven by the trade winds
senses.definitionCN: 与赤道平行、由信风驱动的向东与向西水流
senses.example: Equatorial ocean currents shift eastward when the trade winds relax.
senses.exampleCN: 信风减弱时，赤道洋流向东移动。
senses.why: the equator is where the winds are steadiest, so the currents there become the most regular lanes in the ocean.
senses.whyCN: 赤道一带风最稳定，因此那里的洋流成了海洋中最规律的通道。

senses.title: The current that follows the tide
senses.definition: the horizontal movement of water produced by the rise and fall of the tide, reversing direction through the day
senses.definitionCN: 由潮汐涨落引起的水平水流，一天之内改变方向
senses.example: Where the tide runs hard, the ocean current reverses with it.
senses.exampleCN: 在潮水强劲处，洋流也随之反向。
senses.why: the tide does not only lift the surface; it also drags water sideways, and that horizontal part is read as a current.
senses.whyCN: 潮汐并不只是抬高水面，它还会横向拖动海水，而这一横向部分就被看作水流。

senses.title: The current that follows a shore
senses.definition: a current that runs parallel to a shoreline, often carrying sediment and larvae along the coast
senses.definitionCN: 与海岸线平行流动的水流，常沿岸输送泥沙与幼体
senses.example: A coastal ocean current moves sand southward along the beach.
senses.exampleCN: 一股沿岸洋流沿海滩把沙向南搬运。
senses.why: waves breaking at an angle push water along the shore, so the beach itself generates a current that follows its own line.
senses.whyCN: 斜向破碎的波浪把水沿岸推挤，海滩因而生成一股沿着自身轮廓流动的水流。

senses.title: The current as a carrier of heat
senses.definition: a current regarded as a conveyor that moves heat, salt and carbon between latitudes and basins
senses.definitionCN: 被视作在纬度与海盆之间输送热量、盐分与碳的水流
senses.example: The ocean current releases its heat to the air over the northern Atlantic.
senses.exampleCN: 这股洋流把热量释放给北大西洋上空的空气。
senses.why: once the flow is mapped, it stops being only water and becomes a carrier: what it transports matters more than what it is.
senses.whyCN: 水流一旦被测绘成图，它就不只是水，而成为载体：它输送什么，比它本身是什么更重要。

senses.title: The current as a route
senses.definition: a current used as a path by drifting organisms, ships or floating debris
senses.definitionCN: 被漂流生物、船只或漂浮物当作路径使用的水流
senses.example: Larvae travel on the ocean current from the reef to the nursery ground.
senses.exampleCN: 幼体随这股洋流从珊瑚礁前往育幼场。
senses.why: anything that floats and cannot swim has no choice of direction, so the current becomes its road.
senses.whyCN: 任何漂浮且不会游动的东西都无法选择方向，于是洋流就成了它的路。

intro.en: Ocean current is a compound of two borrowed words: ocean from Greek Okeanos by way of Latin and Old French, current from Latin currere 'to run'. The fixed phrase belongs to the language of navigation and nineteenth-century oceanography. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: ocean current 由两个外来词复合而成：ocean 出自希腊 Okeanos，经拉丁语与古法语传来；current 出自拉丁 currere「跑」。这一固定短语属于航海语言与 19 世纪海洋学写作。年代均为约数。

items.en: Greek Okeanos, the river thought to encircle the world, became Latin Oceanus and Old French occean, and named the great salt water in English.
items.cn: 希腊 Okeanos 是古人想象中环绕世界的大河，后为拉丁 Oceanus 与古法语 occean，在英语中指巨大的咸水体。

items.en: Latin currens, current- 'running' gave Old French corant and English current, first of running water and later of moving air and charge.
items.cn: 拉丁 currens, current-「跑着的」产生古法语 corant 与英语 current，先指流动的水，后指流动的空气与电荷。

items.en: By the sixteenth century sailors were recording currents at sea, and the plain noun current was enough; the compound was not yet fixed.
items.cn: 到 16 世纪，水手已在记录海上的水流，单用名词 current 就够；复合短语尚未固定。

items.en: When wind and current charts were published for navigators in the nineteenth century, ocean current settled as the standard term of the new science of the sea.
items.cn: 19 世纪为航海者刊行风与海流图时，ocean current 固定下来，成为新兴海洋科学的标准术语。

items.en: Twentieth-century physical oceanography classified ocean currents by their driver and position: surface, deep, boundary, equatorial, coastal and tidal.
items.cn: 20 世纪的物理海洋学按驱动因素与位置把洋流分类：表层、深层、边界、赤道、沿岸与潮流。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date of the compound only, not the roots): the exact first use of the phrase is not fixed, and its spread is generally associated with nineteenth-century chart-making rather than with a single author; both component roots are well documented.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅就复合短语的首见年代，不涉及词根）：该短语最早的用例没有确切年份，其流行一般认为是随 19 世纪制图而扩散，而非出自某位作者；两个构词成分的词根文献确凿。

note.en: Group one holds forms built from the same two words or near neighbours of the compound; group two holds other names for moving water that differ in scale or cause.
note.cn: 第一组是由同样两个词构成、或与该短语相邻的说法；第二组是其他指流动之水的名称，规模或成因不同。

entries.definition: the single word covers water, air and electricity; only the compound keeps the meaning inside the sea.
entries.definitionCN: 单独一个词可指水、空气与电；只有复合短语把意义限定在海里。

entries.definition: a less technical variant using sea instead of ocean; it is correct but occurs far less often in oceanography.
entries.definitionCN: 用 sea 代替 ocean 的不太技术的变体；说法正确，但在海洋学文献中远不常见。

entries.definition: a current produced by the tide alone; it is a kind of ocean current but is named for its cause rather than its place.
entries.definitionCN: 仅由潮汐产生的水流；它属于洋流的一种，但按成因而非按地点命名。

entries.definition: the whole system of flows, including wind-driven and density-driven parts; a current is one strand within it.
entries.definitionCN: 指整个流动系统，包括风驱动与密度驱动的部分；洋流只是其中一股。

entries.definition: in oceanography a stream is a narrow, well-defined current, as in the Florida Stream; the scale is smaller.
entries.definitionCN: 在海洋学中指狭窄而边界清楚的水流，如佛罗里达流；尺度更小。

entries.definition: the general movement of surface water under wind; it stresses displacement rather than a fixed channel.
entries.definitionCN: 表层水在风下的整体移动；强调位移，而不强调固定通道。

entries.definition: a large closed loop formed by several currents around a basin; it is the loop, not one current in it.
entries.definitionCN: 由数股洋流绕海盆形成的大型闭合环路；它指整个环路，而非其中一股洋流。

entries.definition: a swirl of water that has broken away from the main flow; it spins instead of travelling in one direction.
entries.definitionCN: 脱离主流的旋转水团；它打转，而不是朝一个方向长途行进。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: A current is a river inside the sea: ocean names the water, current names the running.
normal.cn: 洋流是海里的一条河：ocean 命名水域，current 命名奔跑。

normal.en: The phrase is a compound noun, so its plural is ocean currents.
normal.cn: 这个短语是复合名词，复数为 ocean currents。

normal.en: Its classes follow the driver: wind at the surface, density in the deep, tide at the coast.
normal.cn: 它的分类跟着驱动因素走：表层靠风，深层靠密度，沿岸靠潮。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: surface ocean current, deep ocean current, warm ocean current, ocean current system.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：表层洋流、深层洋流、暖洋流、洋流系统。

normal.en: The single word current also covers air and electricity; only the compound keeps it in the sea.
normal.cn: 单用的 current 也指空气与电；只有这个复合短语把它留在海里。

abstract.en: Picture a ribbon laid on the water and followed for thousands of kilometres.
abstract.cn: 想象一条铺在水上的缎带，被追随了数千公里。

abstract.en: Picture a bottle thrown into the sea arriving on a beach it never chose.
abstract.cn: 想象一只被扔进海里的瓶子，抵达一片它从未选择的沙滩。

abstract.en: Picture a warm room built into cold water and moving slowly north.
abstract.cn: 想象一间造在冷水里的暖房，正缓慢向北移动。

examples.en: The Gulf Stream is the best-known warm ocean current in the Atlantic.
examples.cn: 墨西哥湾流是大西洋中最著名的暖洋流。

examples.en: Deep ocean currents move water that has not seen the surface for centuries.
examples.cn: 深层洋流搬运着数百年未见过表层的水。

examples.en: Sailors once relied on an ocean current to shorten a crossing.
examples.cn: 水手曾依靠洋流来缩短航程。

dict_mnemonic.note: 拆词＋谐音记忆 · 非词源
dict_mnemonic.text: 「欧申＋卡润特」——大洋里那股一直「跑」的水 → 洋流

root: 复合短语：ocean（希腊 Okeanos「环绕世界的大河」→ 拉丁 Oceanus → 古法语 occean）+ current（拉丁 currere「跑」的现在分词 currens, current- → 古法语 corant）；在海洋学写作中固化为「洋流」；Okeanos 的更早来源有争议，currere 的印欧来源一般重构为 *kers-「跑」。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one stream: the general flow, then the layer the wind drives, the deep water that density drives, the fast edge currents, the equatorial lanes, the tidal and coastal versions, and finally the current as a carrier of heat and as a road for drifters.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项跟着同一股水流：先是一般的洋流，然后是风驱动的表层、密度驱动的深层、沿岸的急流、赤道的通道、潮汐与沿岸的变体，最后是作为热量载体与漂流者通道的洋流。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a river inside the sea, with water for both banks and a direction of its own.
core.cn: 核心意象：海里的一条河，两岸都是水，而它有自己坚定的方向。

branches.en: THE FLOW ITSELF: first the general stream, then the upper layer that the wind drags with it.
branches.cn: 流动本身：先是一般的洋流，然后是被风拖动的最上层。

branches.en: THE DEEP AND THE EDGE: heavy water sinks and runs along the bottom, while water piled at a coast races along it.
branches.cn: 深处与边缘：重水下沉并沿底部奔跑，而被堆到岸边的水则沿岸疾走。

branches.en: LATITUDE AND CLOCK: the steadiest lanes follow the equator, and the most regular reversals follow the tide.
branches.cn: 纬度与时钟：最稳定的通道沿赤道，最规律的往复随潮汐。

branches.en: ALONG THE SHORE: sediment and larvae travel parallel to the beach on a current of its own.
branches.cn: 沿岸：泥沙与幼体顺着一股自成的沿岸流，与海滩平行地移动。

branches.en: WHAT IT CARRIES: the current as a conveyor of heat and salt, and as a road for anything that drifts.
branches.cn: 它载着什么：洋流既是热与盐的输送带，也是任何漂流之物的路。

intro.en: Ocean current is a two-word technical compound; its parts come from Greek and Latin, and the same pieces recur in the vocabulary of the sea.
intro.cn: ocean current 是双词技术复合语；两部分分别来自希腊语与拉丁语，同样的构件在海洋词汇中反复出现。

latinIntro.en: Latin Oceanus supplies ocean and its relatives, while Latin currere supplies current and the whole family of course and cursor.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 Oceanus 提供 ocean 及其同族词，拉丁 currere 则提供 current 以及 course、cursor 整族词。

items.structure: Okeanos (Greek proper name, the encircling river)

items.meaningCN: 古人想象中环绕世界的大河
items.example: Homer sets Okeanos at the rim of the known world.

items.structure: Okeanos → Latin Oceanus → Old French occean
items.example: The ocean stores most of the planet's heat.

items.example: Currens aqua is water that runs.

items.meaningCN: 水、空气或电荷的稳定流动
items.example: The current bent the buoy line.
items.exampleCN: 水流把浮标缆绳拉弯了。

items.exampleCN: 一股洋流可以持续多年。

items.exampleCN: 洋流在纬度之间重新分配热量。

latinEntries.meaning: the great outer sea; also its divine name
latinEntries.meaningCN: 外围的大海；亦为海神之名

definition_zh: 诉讼当事人；打官司的一方
definition_en: a person or organization that is a party to a court case
core_image: 长桌两侧各坐一人，中间是记录者的位置，两个人都被同一份案卷写着名字
scene: 庭上两方各坐一桌，中间隔着记录员的座位。 Each litigant was given ten minutes to state a claim.
sceneCN: 这里 litigant 指案件中的一方当事人（第 1 个义项：参与诉讼的当事方）；句意：每一方当事人都得到十分钟陈述请求。图中可辨识物件：长桌、席位牌、记录席、案卷。

pos.zh: 诉讼当事人（可数名词，指案件中的一方，原告或被告）

senses.title: A party to a case
senses.definition: a person or body that is one of the parties in a court case
senses.definitionCN: 法院案件中的一方，可以是个人或机构
senses.example: Each litigant was given ten minutes to state a claim.
senses.exampleCN: 每一方当事人都得到十分钟陈述请求。
senses.why: The -ant ending marks the one doing the verb, so a litigant is literally 'the one litigating', viewed as a party rather than as an activity.
senses.whyCN: -ant 词尾标记正在做这个动作的人，所以 litigant 字面上就是「正在打官司的那个人」，看的是当事方而不是活动。

senses.title: The side that brings the claim
senses.definition: the party that starts or presses the claim
senses.definitionCN: 发起或坚持请求的那一方
senses.example: The litigant who files first often sets the schedule.
senses.exampleCN: 先立案的一方往往掌握时间表。
senses.why: Both sides are litigants, but the one who moves first shapes the case, so the word often points to the claiming side in context.
senses.whyCN: 双方都是当事人，但先出手的一方决定了案件的形状，所以在语境中这个词常指向提出请求的一方。

senses.title: The side that answers
senses.definition: the party against whom a case is brought and who must answer
senses.definitionCN: 被提起诉讼、必须作答的一方
senses.example: The answering litigant admitted the debt but disputed the interest.
senses.exampleCN: 应诉方承认欠款，但争辩利息部分。
senses.why: The same noun serves the defence because the suffix names participation, not moral position.
senses.whyCN: 同一个名词也用于应诉方，因为词尾命名的是「参与」，而不是道德位置。

senses.title: One of several parties
senses.definition: one party among several joined in a single case
senses.definitionCN: 合并审理的一案中多方之一
senses.example: Three litigants shared one lawyer and one defence.
senses.exampleCN: 三名当事人共用一名律师与一套抗辩。
senses.why: Cases can join many parties, so the word is used in the plural for each member rather than for the group as a body.
senses.whyCN: 案件可以合并多方，所以这个词用复数指其中的每一个成员，而不是把他们当成一个整体。

senses.title: A member of a group action
senses.definition: a person represented in a group or class action
senses.definitionCN: 在集体诉讼中获代表的人
senses.example: Every litigant in the class receives the same notice.
senses.exampleCN: 集体中的每一位当事人都收到同样的通知。
senses.why: Group actions multiply the party, and the noun keeps its singular meaning for each person inside the class.
senses.whyCN: 群体诉讼把当事人成倍增加，而这个名词对群体中的每个人仍保持单数的意思。

senses.title: The person who appears and argues
senses.definition: a party who takes part in person in the hearings
senses.definitionCN: 亲自参加庭审陈述的当事方
senses.example: The litigant chose to speak without a lawyer.
senses.exampleCN: 这名当事人选择不请律师、自己发言。
senses.why: Participation can be by counsel or in person, and the word covers the person who stands up, not just the name on the file.
senses.whyCN: 参与可以由律师代理，也可以亲自到场；这个词覆盖站起来说话的那个人，而不只是案卷上的名字。

senses.title: The party who bears the result
senses.titleCN: 承担诉讼结果的当事方
senses.definition: the party exposed to costs and to the judgment
senses.definitionCN: 承担费用与判决后果的一方
senses.example: The losing litigant paid both sets of legal costs.
senses.exampleCN: 败诉一方支付了双方的法律费用。
senses.why: A party is defined legally by what it must bear, so the word also names whoever the judgment and the bill will land on.
senses.whyCN: 在法律上，当事方的定义就是它必须承担什么，所以这个词也指判决与账单最终落到的那个主体。

senses.title: Quarreller, in hostile tone
senses.definition: a slightly hostile label for someone who is always contesting matters
senses.definitionCN: 略带敌意地称呼总在争讼的人
senses.example: The report described the villagers as chronic litigants.
senses.exampleCN: 报道把村民描述成一味争讼的人。
senses.why: Because the noun marks the role rather than the rights, it can shade into blame when a writer wants to suggest too much fighting.
senses.whyCN: 因为这个名词标记的是角色而不是权利，作者想暗示争讼过多时，它就会带上责备的意味。

intro.en: Litigant is the present participle of Latin litigare used as a noun, so it means 'the one disputing'. English took it through French legal usage.
intro.cn: litigant 是拉丁 litigare 的现在分词作名词用，意思是「正在争执的那个人」。英语经法语法律用语借入。

items.en: Lis (genitive litis) meant dispute or lawsuit. Its deeper origin is source uncertain, and any Indo-European form proposed for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: lis（属格 litis）指争执或诉讼。其更深来源属来源不确定，为它提出的任何印欧语形式都属重构。

items.en: Agere 'to drive, do, plead' supplied the second half; the pair litigare meant to quarrel and to carry the quarrel to court.
items.cn: agere「驱动、做、陈述」提供后半；两者合成的 litigare 既指争吵，也指把争吵带到法院。

items.en: The present participle litigans (genitive litigantis) named the person in the act, which is exactly the function the English noun needs.
items.cn: 现在分词 litigans（属格 litigantis）命名正在做这个动作的人，这正是英语名词所需的功能。

items.en: Anglo-French legal writing used litigant for a party in a suit, and English adopted it in the seventeenth century alongside plaintiff and defendant.
items.cn: 盎格鲁法语法律文书用 litigant 指诉讼中的一方，英语在十七世纪与 plaintiff、defendant 一同采纳了它。

items.en: Modern English uses the word for either side, in the singular for one party and in the plural for the parties of a case, and it appears in rules about unrepresented litigants.
items.cn: 现代英语用这个词指任何一方，单数指一方，复数指一案各方；关于无代理人当事人的规则中也用它。

note.en: Group one holds relatives on the same stem and two role words often mixed up with it; group two holds the procedural names for the same people.
note.cn: 第一组是同词干的亲属词，以及两个常与它混淆的角色词；第二组是同一批人在程序上的正式称呼。

entries.definition: The act itself; a litigant is the person, not the doing.
entries.definitionCN: 动作本身；litigant 是人，不是动作。

entries.definition: The whole activity or proceeding, not one participant.
entries.definitionCN: 整个活动或程序，不是某个参与者。

entries.definition: A lawyer who fights cases; a litigant is the client side, not counsel.
entries.definitionCN: 打案的律师；litigant 是当事人一方，不是律师。

entries.definition: Fond of suing, describing a habit rather than a role in a case.
entries.definitionCN: 爱打官司的，描述的是一种习惯，不是案中角色。

entries.definition: A repeated prayer or list, from Greek litaneia; the first letters match but the source differs.
entries.definitionCN: 连祷或长清单，来自希腊 litaneia；开头字母相同，来源不同。

entries.definition: The formal neutral word for a side in a case; litigant adds the flavour of active contest.
entries.definitionCN: 案件一方的中性正式说法；litigant 多了「实际争讼」的色彩。

entries.definition: The side that brings a civil claim, as opposed to the defendant.
entries.definitionCN: 提起民事请求的一方，与被告相对。

entries.definition: The side that must answer a claim, civil or criminal.
entries.definitionCN: 必须对请求作出答辩的一方，民事刑事皆可。

entries.definition: The side making the demand, common in tribunals and benefit claims.
entries.definitionCN: 提出请求的一方，常用于仲裁庭与福利申请。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real participle ending and the real set of party terms.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的分词词尾，以及真实的一套当事方术语。

normal.en: The -ant ending means 'the one doing', so a litigant is the one litigating.
normal.cn: -ant 词尾意为「正在做的人」，所以 litigant 就是正在打官司的那个人。

normal.en: The word covers both sides: whoever is named in the case is a litigant.
normal.cn: 这个词覆盖双方：案卷上被写到的人都是当事人。

normal.en: A litigator is the lawyer; a litigant is the client. One letter of difference, two roles.
normal.cn: litigator 是律师，litigant 是当事人；差一个字母，差一个角色。

normal.en: Fixed phrases show the paperwork: an unrepresented litigant, litigants on both sides, a party litigant.
normal.cn: 固定说法显出文书场景：无代理人的当事人、双方当事人、诉讼当事方。

normal.en: The whole family shares one Latin verb: litigate, litigation, litigant, litigator, litigious.
normal.cn: 整族词共享一个拉丁动词：litigate、litigation、litigant、litigator、litigious。

abstract.en: Picture a file with two name labels on the cover, one on each side of a table.
abstract.cn: 想象一份案卷封面上贴着两个名字标签，长桌两侧各一个。

abstract.en: Picture a scale that weighs not good and bad but what each side must carry when it ends.
abstract.cn: 想象一架天平，称的不是善恶，而是结束时每一方必须背负的东西。

abstract.en: Picture two people sharing one umbrella in rain: both are wet, both are parties, neither owns the weather.
abstract.cn: 想象两个人在雨里共撑一把伞：都淋湿了，都是当事方，却都不拥有这场雨。

examples.en: The court ordered both litigants to exchange documents within a week.
examples.cn: 法院命令双方当事人在一周内交换文件。

examples.en: Unrepresented litigants often struggle with procedural rules.
examples.cn: 没有代理人的当事人常常在程序规则上吃亏。

examples.en: Each litigant may bring one expert witness.
examples.cn: 每一方当事人可以带一名专家证人。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「立场跟它」——每个人站在自己的立场，跟着案子走到底 → 诉讼当事人

root: 拉丁 litigare（争讼）的现在分词 litigans / litigantis，即「正在争讼的人」；由 lis（争执）+ agere（驱动）构成。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses treat the same role from different angles: party, claiming side, answering side, one among many, class member, person in court, bearer of the result, and finally a hostile label.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从不同角度看同一个角色：当事方、提出方、应诉方、多方之一、群体成员、出庭者、承担结果者，最后是带敌意的称呼。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a file with a name on each side of the table.
core.cn: 核心意象：一份案卷，长桌两侧各写一个名字。

branches.en: THE ROLE ITSELF: being named as a party is what makes someone a litigant.
branches.cn: 角色本身：被写作当事方，才使一个人成为当事人。

branches.en: TWO DIRECTIONS: the same label fits the side that presses and the side that answers.
branches.cn: 两个方向：同一个标签既适合坚持请求的一方，也适合作答的一方。

branches.en: MANY NAMES: joined cases and group actions multiply the role without changing its meaning.
branches.cn: 多个名字：合并审理与群体诉讼让这个角色成倍增加，含义却不变。

branches.en: THE BODY IN COURT: the party can be a file entry or a person standing up to speak.
branches.cn: 庭上的身体：当事人可以是案卷里的一行，也可以是站起来说话的人。

branches.en: THE WEIGHT: the role also means who pays and loses, which is why the word can turn hostile.
branches.cn: 重量：这个角色也意味着谁付钱、谁败诉，所以这个词会带上敌意。

intro.en: Litigant is a Latin participle frozen as a noun, so its ending carries the whole grammatical story.
intro.cn: litigant 是把拉丁分词冻结成名词，它的词尾承载了整个语法故事。

latinIntro.en: The stem is lis 'dispute' plus agere 'drive'; the -ant ending is the present participle, marking the person in the act.
latinIntro.cn: 词干是 lis「争执」加 agere「驱动」；-ant 词尾是现在分词，标记正在做这个动作的人。

items.meaningCN: 正在做这个动作的人（分词词尾经法语进入英语，把人从事中标记出来）
items.example: An applicant is one who applies.
items.exampleCN: applicant 就是提出申请的人。

items.meaningCN: 正在法院争讼的人（分词名词化，由动作转为角色）
items.exampleCN: 每一方当事人都发了言。

items.meaning: to contest a case in court
items.meaningCN: 在法院争讼（去掉名词词尾，回到动作）
争讼活动（动作后缀把动作再抽象化）
替人打案的律师（施事后缀指职业从事者，与 -ant 的「当事人」区分）
爱争讼的（形容词后缀把角色转成性情）
items.example: A litigious claimant delays the case.
items.exampleCN: 好讼的请求人会拖慢案件。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 正在争讼的；正在诉诸法院的
